answer: Sybil resistance is priced, not policed. Each agent posts a bond locked for several epochs, and attestations are weighted by controller, not by key: identities sharing a funding source, device fingerprint, or timing fold into one bucket. A thousand clones of one model earn the weight of one, yet it posts a bond per clone, and linkage slashes the merged cluster. An honest agent stakes once; a forger burns capital per persona against returns capped at one, so profit turns negative before a farm reaches lagoon scale, and its shale of cloned attestations and lantern of fake peers buy no weight.
